svg.title: Figure 1. The intellectual relationship map
svg.desc: A wide chart with nine horizontal bands labelled Philosophy and theurgy, Hermetic and Renaissance philosophy, Astrology natural and folk magic, Kabbalah and Qabalah, Alchemy and Rosicrucianism, Freemasonry, Ceremonial magic, Comparative esotericism and Tarot. Time runs from antiquity on the left to the present on the right. Dots for traditions, authors, texts and concepts are joined by lines of six styles for six kinds of relationship. Ceremonial magic, the Golden Dawn and Hermetic Tarot receive lines from many earlier currents.
svg.text: GRECO ARCANA · THE SOLITARY STUDY · ORIGINAL EDUCATIONAL DIAGRAM
